title: A member whose name on the gym list starts with a title, or is written surname first, never sees their plan or workout plans in the app
what: My membership and the gym's workout plans show only when the first word of the name on the gym list equals the first word of the name the member gave in the app. Only an ordinary space splits the words and nothing else is cleaned. 'Dr. Rahul Sharma', 'Mr Rahul', 'Sharma Rahul' on the list, or a name pasted with a non-breaking space, never match 'Rahul' in the app. The member only sees that the gym has a different name for their number, and the desk sees nothing.
expected: Common titles are dropped, any kind of space splits the name, and a match on any word of the list name is enough; when it still does not match, the desk is told which member to fix.
how_often: every time for a member listed with a title or surname first
fix_line: Make the name check drop titles, split on any space and accept any word of the listed name

evidence: data-count: Crispy Curves live app members 1, with a proven check-in number 0
data-count: Crispy Curves memberships 2, with a trainer 0
